understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the goal gem tile marked + in each level, avoiding spikes and continuing until the game is won.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Move horizontally with MOVE_LEFT or MOVE_RIGHT; after moving, gravity automatically carries the player until landing on a solid tile, hitting a spike, or reaching the goal. CLICK removes an indicated breakable block and does not advance the rising-platform timer. Use landing previews and corridor passages to choose safe routes, and use UNDO to reverse the previous action when needed. Each level allows two attempts of up to 50 turns.
